pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown polygonal regions with softened edges characterized by smooth pixel gradients. Patch geometry varies from large, elongated shapes on the neck to smaller, more equilateral quadrilaterals and pentagons on the shoulder and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly at the dorsal transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent horizontal integumentary folds are visible on the ventral-lateral aspect of the lower neck.
